test_cases.name: FF frozen input preserves BOM, CRLF, trailing spaces, CJK, emoji and code blocks
FF rejects oversize UTF-8 and forged hashes
FF SHA-256 follows fixed canonicalization and preserves formatting
FF duplicate operation is idempotent across revision changes but conflicting replay fails
FF unknown attempt is not silently retried or replaced
FF status machine requires distinct completion signals and one task
FF update rejects tampering with createOperationId or createdAt
FF rejects non-transactional or invalid revision updates
turning FF off before queued CREATE commits must reject the stale operation
